description: Data on which named businesses ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini name when asked a buyer's own questions, by business category and city, from Continuum's monthly probe panels. Panels available today: bookkeepers in Denver; HVAC companies in Dallas; marketing agencies in Salt Lake City; web designers in Minneapolis. Pass category and/or city as free text to look one panel up (loose match, e.g. "HVAC" or "Dallas"); pass list=true or no arguments to see every available panel with its measurement date. Each result states the snapshot month and the refresh cadence (monthly), the businesses named and how many times, the AI tool(s) that named each one, and the directories, review sites and forums the answers cited. It states no number that is not in the stored panel. Read-only: looks up stored data, runs no new AI probe. Free: 5 calls per caller per day. Beyond that, pass api_key from an active Agent Data subscription ($9/mo) for unlimited calls; a result without one past the free limit includes the subscription link. Same data as the public page linked in each result; this tool is a convenience for programmatic access to it, not a different or more current dataset. A weekly tracker for one business's own questions (whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini name it, week over week) is in early access at https://uxcontinuum.com/labs/ai-rank-tracker; this tool does not track a single business.

api_key.description: An Agent Data subscription key, if the caller has one. Lifts the daily free-call limit.

category.description: Business category, free text, e.g. "HVAC companies" or "bookkeepers". Loosely matched.

city.description: City, free text, e.g. "Dallas". Loosely matched.

list.description: List every available panel instead of looking one up.
